entities.name: Eron the Relentless
entities.description: The immortal king of the Goblins of the Koskun Mountains of Ulgrotha, once a street urchin and thief in Aysen.

entities.name: Bernatheen
entities.description: A Wizard Savant of the Floating Island who made Eron immortal and was later twisted into a greater werewolf by Baron Sengir.

entities.name: Grandmother Sengir
entities.description: The owner of the library at Castle Sengir from which Eron stole a book.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: An immortal who twisted Bernatheen into a werewolf and has tried to meet Eron, who fears him.

entities.name: Chandler
entities.description: A thief who deprived Eron of his Ebony Rhino.

entities.name: Joven
entities.description: A thief who, with Chandler, deprived Eron of his Ebony Rhino.

entities.name: Goblins of the Koskun Mountains
entities.description: Goblins who accepted Eron as their king.

entities.name: Anaba minotaurs
entities.description: Minotaurs used by Eron as bodyguards; he seeks their hidden homeland.

entities.name: Koskun Keep
entities.description: Eron's goblin stronghold, a refuge for criminals of the Homelands.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: The plane where the Koskun Mountains lie.

entities.name: Aysen
entities.description: Eron's home city and a trade partner by treaty.

entities.name: Ebony Rhino
entities.description: A possession of Eron stolen by Chandler and Joven.

events.summary: Eron steals a dark magic book from Grandmother Sengir's library for the Savant Bernatheen and asks that the last spell in it be cast on him.
events.quote: Eron found Grandmother Sengir asleep near a tome and stole it.

events.summary: The spell makes Eron immortal and immune to aging.
events.quote: Eron discovered he was immortal and immune to aging.

events.summary: Baron Sengir finds out Bernatheen and twists him into a greater werewolf as punishment.
events.quote: Bernatheen was later found out by Baron Sengir and twisted into a greater werewolf as punishment.

events.summary: Eron declares himself King of the Goblins at Koskun Keep, is killed and rises again, and the goblins accept him as king.
events.quote: He traveled to Koskun Keep , where he declared himself King of the Goblins.

events.summary: Eron forms a treaty with Aysen to keep his subordinates from invading in exchange for trade of food and goods.
events.quote: Eron formed a treaty with Aysen

relations.quote: is the immortal king of the Goblins of the Koskun Mountains of Ulgrotha .

relations.note: Punished Bernatheen by twisting him into a werewolf.
relations.quote: Bernatheen was later found out by Baron Sengir and twisted into a greater werewolf as punishment.

relations.note: Has sworn to make the thieves pay for taking his Ebony Rhino.
relations.quote: he has taken a special dislike to the thieves Chandler and Joven

relations.note: A fellow immortal who has tried to meet Eron; Eron refuses and fears the Baron is biding his time.
relations.quote: Baron Sengir has tried many times to meet Eron, a fellow immortal, but the latter has always refused.
